title: calesthio/OpenMontage
claim: calesthio/OpenMontage — World's first open-source, agentic video production system. 12 production pipelines, 100+ tools, 700+ agent skill and pr
why_good: The integration of agentic systems in video production could streamline workflows and reduce costs for content creators.
value: Content creators and production companies could pay for premium features, support, or customized tools, creating a subscription or licensing model.
risk: The project may struggle to compete against established video production software that has more resources and brand recognition.
